class.name: openarm_hardware/OpenArm_v10HW
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for OpenArm V10.

class.name: openarm_hardware/OpenArm_v10LPF_HW
class.description: LPF-enhanced OpenArm V10 hardware interface. Adds a Low-Pass Filter on position commands (cmd_filter_cutoff_hz param, default 10 Hz) while inheriting all motor control, gravity/friction compensation, LEAP Hand, and O6 Hand functionality from OpenArm_v10HW.

class.name: openarm_hardware/LeapHandHardware
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for LEAP Hand via Dynamixel serial communication.

class.name: openarm_hardware/O6HandHardware
class.description: ros2_control hardware interface for O6 Hand (LinkerHand) via CAN communication using LinkerHandApi.
